opening.argument: The presentation offers a purported $1,500 Best Buy gift card in exchange for providing an email address and clicking an external link. The speaker states, "Only with your email you can win 1,500 dollars in a gift card of Best Buy!" and directs viewers to "click on the link below on the description of this video." The description reinforces that viewers can click a shortened bit.ly link and submit an email to obtain the claimed reward. Although the description calls it a draw, it also says the gift card is "for you," presenting an uncertain prize as a readily available benefit. The requested action therefore sends viewers to an external destination to provide contact information for a low-barrier reward claim.

citations.quote: Only with your email you can win 1,500 dollars in a gift card of Best Buy!
You only have to click on the link below on the description of this video.
If you click here http://bit.ly/1500usd-best-buy you can win a gift card of Best Buy with $1500 for you. You only need your email.
